source.notes: arch-068 (A13 score/reducer). Threshold Rectified Attention: out = (ReLU(Q@K^T − τ))^p @ V with position-dependent threshold τ_i = β·sqrt(2·log(i+1)/d), causal mask zeroing j>i before the threshold, NO normalization denominator — the typed K1ReducerLaw.THRESHOLD_RELU_POWER reducer. Differential variant: optional cosine L2-normalization of q1/k1/q2/k2, two threshold-ReLU paths, out = out1 − clamp(λ,0,1)·out2 — the admitted Diff combinator (typed Merge). Verified against the pinned tda triton_threshold_attention.py. Layer module: architectures/tda.py.
